body: Requirement clarification recorded in docs/reports/desktop-control-contract.md, commit 647f689b449804b7d647fd298fac2c36d6e99a07: G3 requires trustworthy qualified user AUTHORIZATION of exact immutable captured bytes/decision under original epoch/recipient, NOT physical/human authorship of each IME/paste byte or universal continuous-memory attestation. Legitimate fresh paste may authorize exact captured software-produced bytes, which remain untrusted data; cannot authorize changed data, different target/generation or future renderer stream. Missing shared eventID alone does not show safe composition impossible. Existing raw assertion stays SOURCE-rejected only, no native exploit/universal impossibility claimed. Broker-mediated modification/delegation stays included; arbitrary outside-broker same-user code excluded. Parent awaits macOS entitlement/device-path clarification. No code/native/frontend changes, tests rerun, credentials/hardware/biometry mandate, permission, claim change, submit/fail/accept.
